title: Company Founding & Leadership
content: NovaTech was founded in October 2019 by Dr. Priya Shah and Marcus Vance. The company is headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

title: Core Product & Architecture
content: NovaTech's primary product is NovaSync, an enterprise distributed stream orchestration platform designed for real-time telemetry processing.

title: Supported Platforms & Operating Systems
content: NovaSync officially supports server installations on Linux distributions (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS+, RHEL 8+, Debian 11+) and Kubernetes 1.25+. Windows Server is currently in an invite-only private preview and is not supported in production.

title: Pricing & Packaging Tiers
content: NovaSync Standard tier costs $499 per month per cluster, covering up to 5 worker nodes. The Enterprise tier features custom volume pricing, dedicated technical account management, and multi-region failover.

title: Team Size & Office Locations
content: As of Q3 2024, NovaTech employs 42 full-time staff across engineering, security, and customer operations, with offices in Seattle and London.

title: Technology Stack & Storage
content: NovaSync's core streaming engine is written in Rust. The management plane APIs are developed in Go with gRPC, and metadata persistence is handled via clustered PostgreSQL.

title: Service Level Agreement & Support
content: Enterprise tier customers receive a guaranteed 99.95% monthly uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA) with a 1-hour critical incident response time.

title: Compliance & Security Standards
content: NovaTech completed its SOC 2 Type II audit in January 2023 and received ISO/IEC 27001 certification in November 2023. End-to-end data encryption is enforced using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

title: Data Retention & Storage Limits
content: NovaSync retains uncompressed raw event telemetry for a maximum of 30 days. Compacted hourly summary rollups are retained for up to 365 days by default.

title: Funding History & Venture Investors
content: NovaTech raised a $4.2M Seed round in March 2021 led by Horizon Ventures, followed by an $18M Series A in June 2023 led by Apex Capital Partners.
